note: Spec frozen WHILE the gate run is in progress; the constants below were extracted verbatim from the running script (unchanged since run start). Post-run verification: gate artifact must match these numbers exactly.
injection_waveform: h(t) = A exp(-(t-t0)/tau) sin(2 pi f (t-t0)) * [t>=t0]; A chosen so that sqrt(sum(h^2))/sigma_whitened = SNR
detection_criterion: pencil cluster within F_TOL_HZ of injected f AND relative tau error <= TAU_TOL_REL AND cluster amp >= off-source amp-99%

gate_criteria.efficiency_floor_high: min efficiency over all cells at SNR>=12 >= 0.90
gate_criteria.efficiency_floor_low: min efficiency over all cells at SNR>=8 >= 0.70
gate_criteria.per_detector: H1 and L1 each evaluated independently; gate passes only if BOTH pass

no_threshold_post_adjustment: Any gate failure -> document, fix extractor, NEW gate run. No threshold changes after seeing results.

v2_revision.trigger: first gate run (r1) FAILED: efficiency 0.0 at all SNRs, both detectors
v2_revision.root_cause: two extractor defects, found by isolating the pencil on a pure synthetic damped sinusoid: (a) the zero-padded pre-onset section of the analysis window destroyed tau estimation; (b) cluster tau averaging over mixed poles washed out the true value. Fix: pencil runs on the post-onset segment only; cluster tau taken from the strongest member.
v2_revision.note: r2 gate run started after this entry; verdict against the SAME frozen floors
